name: National Bank of Kuwait - Egypt
source: National Bank of Kuwait - Egypt (S.A.E), Auditors report and financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (audited, translation of statements originally issued in Arabic), EGP thousand, stored absolute
source_note: Read from the audited FY2025 statements of National Bank of Kuwait - Egypt on nbk.com, in EGP thousand stored absolute. A bank has no Cost of Sales, Gross Profit or Net Finance Costs line and none is invented here: Revenue is the printed Net Operating Income (net interest income plus net fees, dividends, trading and investment gains) and Operating Expenses is the printed General and administrative expenses. The printed lines tie exactly: 16,035,624 - 401,649 impairment - 3,758,606 general and administrative - 275,507 other operating = 11,599,862 Profit Before Tax, and 11,599,862 - 3,510,082 tax = 8,089,780 Net Profit. Ratios are derived from the statements below, not sourced.
